Just finished watching Mr.Robot, and I gotta say that it wasn't that impressive...highly overrated.
It's a weird show and unpredictable. The plot twists and turns, that's why I like it.

Unfortunately thanks to all the love the show got you probably had way higher expectations than the show could live up to. There's a good chance that if you started watching episodes as they were released you'd think differently. Of course everyone has different tastes and to be sure it's not a great show, but it does many things very well and in particular that thing -- hacker culture -- that Hollywood usually screws up (and to be clear I'm not saying it's necessarily accurate, or in accurate for that matter, but at least it wasn't the usual cliche filled drivel that we've been subjected to since the 80s).

It's like Gotham. There's so much hate for that show because everyone who's invested in the Batman universe already has these huge expectations and standards for it. But it's a really great watch with some very memorable characters and writing, yet no one's prepared to give it a chance.
It's the best show I've ever seen that wasn't on HBO or Showtime.
